en.p80_t1_instr1:
<bold>Take a deep breath and sustain the vowel /aaa/ in one breath as long and as steadily as possible. The phonation should least 10 seconds.
I will now play you an example.</bold>

<italic>Press PLAY EXAMPLE to play the example.</italic>
en.p80_t1_instr2:
<bold>Start now.</bold>

<italic>Press the START button to begin recording. Wait until the participant is out of breath and then press STOP.
Do not stop the participant; let them phonate as long as possible.
If the phonation is shorter than 10 seconds, encourage the participant to prolong it. Changing the pitch or lowering the loudness of the phonation often helps.</italic>
en.p80_t2_instr1:
<bold>I will now play you an audio recording of a fairy tale. Your task is to remember it and then retell it in your own words.</bold>

<bold>The retelling should last 90 seconds. The goal is to speak continuously; it does not matter whether the tale is retold correctly or completely.</bold>

<italic>Press PLAY EXAMPLE to start the story playback.</italic>
en.p80_t2_instr2:
<bold>Start now.</bold>

<italic>Press the START button to begin recording. Wait until 90 seconds have passed on the stopwatch, then press the STOP button to end the recording.</italic>
en.p80_f_patient_code_help: Study code of the participant, e.g. HC001.
